title: Ortolan bunting
blurb: The ortolan, also called ortolan bunting, is a Eurasian bird in the bunting family Emberizidae, a passerine family now separated by most modern scholars from the finches, Fringillidae.
facts: The specific name hortulana is from the Italian name for this bird, ortolana.
The English ortolan is derived from Middle French hortolan, "gardener".
